licenses_intro: This app uses the following open-source software.
addendum_privacy: This Policy takes effect on April 16, 2026.
addendum_terms: These Terms take effect on April 16, 2026.

privacy_sections.title: Article 1 (Purpose)
privacy_sections.body: Chaeon Studio (hereinafter the "Company") establishes this Privacy Policy (hereinafter the "Policy") to protect the information (hereinafter "Personal Information") of individuals (hereinafter "Users" or "Individuals") using the services the Company provides (hereinafter the "Services"), to comply with the Personal Information Protection Act, the Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection (hereinafter the "Network Act"), and other applicable laws, and to promptly and smoothly address User concerns regarding the protection of personal information.

privacy_sections.title: Article 2 (Principles of Processing Personal Information)
privacy_sections.body: In accordance with applicable privacy laws and this Policy, the Company may collect Users' Personal Information. Collected Personal Information may only be provided to third parties with the individual's consent. However, where lawfully compelled by statute or similar requirement, the Company may provide collected Personal Information to third parties without the individual's prior consent.

privacy_sections.title: Article 3 (Disclosure of this Policy)
privacy_sections.body:
① The Company discloses this Policy on the first screen of its homepage, or on a page linked from the first screen, so that Users can review it at any time with ease.

② When disclosing this Policy under Paragraph 1, the Company uses font sizes, colors, and similar measures to make the Policy easy to read.

privacy_sections.title: Article 4 (Amendments to this Policy)
privacy_sections.body:
① This Policy may be amended in response to changes in privacy laws, guidelines, notices, or government or Company policies and service content.

② When amending this Policy under Paragraph 1, the Company will give notice by one or more of the following methods:
a. Notice via the announcement section on the first screen of the Company's homepage or via a separate pop-up.
b. Notice to Users in writing, by fax, email, or a similar method.

③ Notice under Paragraph 2 will be given at least 7 days before the amended Policy takes effect. Where the amendment involves a material change to User rights, the Company will give notice at least 30 days in advance.

privacy_sections.title: Article 5 (Information Collected for Account Registration)
privacy_sections.body:
The Company collects the following information in order to register Users for the Services.

Required: email address

privacy_sections.title: Article 6 (Information Collected for Payment Services)
privacy_sections.body:
The Company collects the following information in order to provide payment services.

Required: card number, card password, and expiration date

privacy_sections.title: Article 7 (Methods of Collecting Personal Information)
privacy_sections.body:
The Company collects Users' Personal Information by the following methods.

① The User enters Personal Information on the Company's homepage.

② The User enters Personal Information through a service provided by the Company outside of its homepage, such as its mobile application.

③ Information the User enters in the course of using Company services, such as customer support inquiries or posts on community boards.

privacy_sections.title: Article 8 (Use of Personal Information)
privacy_sections.body:
The Company uses Personal Information for the following purposes.

① To carry out Company operations, including delivering announcements.

② To improve services for Users, including responding to inquiries and handling complaints.

③ To provide the Services.

④ To prevent and sanction conduct that disrupts the smooth operation of the Services, including measures restricting use by members who violate applicable laws or the Company's terms, and including fraudulent use.

⑤ To conduct demographic analysis and to analyze service visits and usage records.

privacy_sections.title: Article 9 (Delegation of Processing)
privacy_sections.body:
To provide the Services smoothly and efficiently, the Company delegates the processing of Personal Information as follows.

① Amazon Web Services (AWS): server infrastructure operation, data storage and processing — until account deletion or termination of the delegation contract.

② Google Firebase: push notification delivery — until account deletion or termination of the delegation contract.

③ Toss Payments: payment processing — until account deletion or termination of the delegation contract.

④ Anthropic: OCR analysis of prescription images — deleted immediately upon completion of processing.

privacy_sections.title: Article 10 (Retention and Use Period of Personal Information)
privacy_sections.body:
① The Company retains and uses Users' Personal Information for the period necessary to achieve the purposes for which it was collected and used.

② Notwithstanding the preceding paragraph, the Company retains records of abusive service use for up to one year after account deletion, under its internal policy, for the purpose of preventing fraudulent registration and use.

privacy_sections.title: Article 11 (Retention and Use Period Required by Law)
privacy_sections.body:
The Company retains and uses Personal Information as follows, in accordance with applicable laws.

① Act on the Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce, Etc.
a. Records on contracts and withdrawal of subscriptions: 5 years
b. Records on payment and supply of goods and services: 5 years
c. Records on consumer complaints or dispute resolution: 3 years
d. Records on display and advertising: 6 months

② Protection of Communications Secrets Act
a. Website log records: 3 months

③ Electronic Financial Transactions Act
a. Records on electronic financial transactions: 5 years

④ Act on the Protection, Use, Etc. of Location Information
a. Records on personal location information: 6 months

privacy_sections.title: Article 12 (Principle of Destruction)
privacy_sections.body: As a general rule, when Personal Information is no longer necessary — for example, because the processing purpose has been achieved or the retention and use period has expired — the Company destroys it without delay.

privacy_sections.title: Article 13 (Procedure for Destruction)
privacy_sections.body:
① Information entered by a User for account registration and similar purposes is, after the processing purpose has been achieved, transferred to a separate database (or, in the case of paper records, a separate filing cabinet) where it is stored for a defined period under the Company's internal policy and other applicable laws for information-protection reasons, and is then destroyed.

② Personal Information for which grounds for destruction have arisen is destroyed with the approval of the person in charge of personal information protection.

privacy_sections.title: Article 14 (Method of Destruction)
privacy_sections.body: Personal Information stored in electronic file form is deleted using technical means that make the records impossible to reproduce. Personal Information printed on paper is destroyed by shredding or incineration.

privacy_sections.title: Article 15 (Measures Regarding the Transmission of Advertising Information)
privacy_sections.body:
① Where the Company transmits commercial advertising information by electronic means, it obtains the User's explicit prior consent. However, prior consent is not required in the following cases:
a. Where the Company obtained the recipient's contact details directly from the recipient through a transactional relationship, and intends to transmit advertising information about similar goods within six months from the end of that transaction.
b. Where a telemarketing seller under the Act on Door-to-Door Sales, Etc. discloses the source of the collected personal information to the recipient orally and makes the telemarketing call.

② Where the recipient indicates a refusal to receive, or withdraws prior consent, the Company does not transmit commercial advertising information and notifies the recipient of the outcome of the refusal or withdrawal.

③ Where the Company transmits commercial advertising information by electronic means between 9 p.m. and 8 a.m. the following day, it obtains separate prior consent from the recipient.

privacy_sections.title: Article 16 (Protection of Children's Personal Information)
privacy_sections.body:
① To protect the personal information of children under 14, the Company permits account registration only for Users aged 14 or older.

② Notwithstanding Paragraph 1, where the User is a child under the age of 14, the Company obtains consent to the collection, use, and provision of personal information from the child's legal representative.

③ In the case of Paragraph 2, the Company additionally collects information such as the legal representative's name, date of birth, sex, duplicate-registration verification (CI/DI), and mobile phone number.

privacy_sections.title: Article 17 (Access to Personal Information and Withdrawal of Consent to Collection)
privacy_sections.body:
① Users and their legal representatives may at any time review or correct their registered personal information and may request withdrawal of consent to the collection of personal information.

② To withdraw consent to the collection of registration information, Users and their legal representatives may contact the person in charge of personal information protection, or the person responsible for such matters, in writing, by telephone, or by email. The Company will act on such requests without delay.

privacy_sections.title: Article 18 (Changes to Personal Information)
privacy_sections.body:
① Users may request that the Company correct errors in their personal information by the methods described in the preceding article.

② In such cases, the Company does not use or provide the personal information until correction is completed. Where incorrect personal information has already been provided to a third party, the Company will promptly notify that third party of the outcome of the correction so that the correction is carried through.

privacy_sections.title: Article 19 (User Obligations)
privacy_sections.body:
① Users must keep their personal information up to date, and are responsible for any issues arising from inaccurate information they provide.

② Registering an account using another person's personal information may result in loss of User status or punishment under applicable privacy laws.

③ Users are responsible for maintaining the security of their email address, password, and similar credentials, and may not transfer or lend them to any third party.

privacy_sections.title: Article 20 (The Company's Management of Personal Information)
privacy_sections.body: In processing Users' personal information, the Company takes the technical and administrative safeguards necessary to ensure security against loss, theft, leakage, alteration, damage, and similar risks.

privacy_sections.title: Article 21 (Handling of Deleted Information)
privacy_sections.body: Personal information that has been terminated or deleted at the request of a User or their legal representative is handled as set out in "Retention and Use Period of Personal Information" and cannot be viewed or used for any other purpose.

privacy_sections.title: Article 22 (Password Encryption)
privacy_sections.body: Users' passwords are stored and managed using one-way encryption. Verification and modification of personal information is only possible by the individual who knows the password.

privacy_sections.title: Article 23 (Measures Against Hacking and Similar Threats)
privacy_sections.body:
① The Company uses its best efforts to prevent Users' personal information from being leaked or damaged by intrusions into information and communications networks, including hacking and computer viruses.

② The Company uses up-to-date antivirus software to prevent Users' personal information and data from being leaked or damaged.

③ The Company operates intrusion prevention systems to ensure security against unforeseen events.

④ The Company ensures that sensitive personal information can be transmitted safely over networks, including through encrypted communications.

privacy_sections.title: Article 24 (Minimization of Processing and Staff Training)
privacy_sections.body: The Company limits the number of staff handling personal information to the minimum necessary and, through training and other administrative measures, emphasizes compliance with applicable laws and the Company's internal policies.

privacy_sections.title: Article 25 (Response to Leakage of Personal Information)
privacy_sections.body:
Upon becoming aware of the loss, theft, or leakage of personal information, the Company will, without delay, notify the affected User of all of the following items and report the incident to the Korea Communications Commission or the Korea Internet & Security Agency.

① The items of personal information affected
② The time at which the leakage occurred
③ The measures the User may take
④ The measures taken in response by the information and communications service provider
⑤ The department and contact information where the User may seek guidance

privacy_sections.title: Article 26 (Exceptions to the Response Measures)
privacy_sections.body: Notwithstanding the preceding article, where a legitimate reason exists — such as the Company being unable to determine the User's contact information — the Company may satisfy the notice requirement of the preceding article by posting the notice on its homepage for at least 30 days.

privacy_sections.title: Article 27 (Protection of Personal Information Transferred Overseas)
privacy_sections.body:
① The Company does not enter into any international agreement concerning Users' personal information that would violate the Personal Information Protection Act or other applicable laws.

② Where the Company provides, delegates the processing of, or stores Users' personal information abroad, it obtains consent from the User. However, where the Company has publicly disclosed or notified the User in accordance with applicable laws, separate consent for delegation or storage of processing is not required.

③ Where the Company seeks consent under the main text of Paragraph 2 of this article, it notifies the User in advance of all of the following:
a. The items of personal information to be transferred.
b. The country to which, the date and time at which, and the method by which the personal information will be transferred.
c. The name of the recipient (or, in the case of a corporation, its name and the contact information of its information management officer).
d. The recipient's purpose of use and its retention and use period.

privacy_sections.title: Article 28 (Installation, Operation, and Refusal of Automatic Collection Devices)
privacy_sections.body:
① To provide personalized services to Users, the Company uses automatic information collection devices (hereinafter "cookies") that store and frequently recall usage information. Cookies are small pieces of information that a server (http) operating the website sends to the User's web browser and that may be stored on the User's device.

② Users may choose whether to install cookies. By configuring browser options, Users may allow all cookies, be prompted each time a cookie is stored, or refuse all cookies.

③ Note that refusing cookies may make it difficult to use some Company services that require sign-in.

privacy_sections.title: Article 29 (How to Configure Cookie Permissions)
privacy_sections.body:
You can allow or block cookies through your web browser's options.

Edge: Settings menu (top right) > Cookies and site permissions > Manage and delete cookies and site data
Chrome: Settings menu (top right) > Privacy and security > Cookies and other site data
Whale: Settings menu (top right) > Privacy > Cookies and other site data

privacy_sections.title: Article 30 (Designation of Personal Information Protection Officer)
privacy_sections.body:
To protect Users' personal information and handle related complaints, the Company designates the following department and personal information protection officer.

Personal Information Protection Officer
Email: yamisupport@gmail.com

privacy_sections.title: Article 31 (Remedies for Infringement of Rights)
privacy_sections.body:
① A data subject may apply for dispute resolution or consultation with the Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee, the Privacy Infringement Report Center of the Korea Internet & Security Agency, and similar bodies to obtain relief for infringement of personal information.
a. Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee: 1833-6972 (www.kopico.go.kr)
b. Privacy Infringement Report Center: 118 (privacy.kisa.or.kr)
c. Supreme Prosecutors' Office: 1301 (www.spo.go.kr)
d. National Police Agency: 182 (ecrm.cyber.go.kr)

② The Company strives to guarantee the data subject's right to self-determination regarding personal information and to provide consultation and relief for personal information infringement. For reports or consultation, please contact the department listed in Paragraph 1.

③ A person whose rights or interests are infringed by a disposition or omission by the head of a public institution in response to a request under Articles 35, 36, or 37 of the Personal Information Protection Act may file an administrative appeal in accordance with the Administrative Appeals Act.
a. Central Administrative Appeals Commission: 110 (www.simpan.go.kr)

terms_sections.title: Article 1 (Purpose)
terms_sections.body: These Terms are intended to set out the fundamental matters — including the rights, obligations, and responsibilities of the parties, and the conditions and procedures for use of the Services — with respect to use of the DearMI service (hereinafter the "Services") provided by Chaeon Studio (hereinafter the "Company") and the relationship between the Company and its Users.

terms_sections.title: Article 2 (Definitions)
terms_sections.body:
The definitions of terms used in these Terms are as follows.

① "Services" means the DearMI application provided by the Company and all features related to it.

② "User" means any member or non-member who uses the Services provided by the Company in accordance with these Terms.

③ "Member" means a person who has entered into a service-use agreement with the Company and uses the Services.

④ "Free Plan" means the basic service available without a separate subscription fee.

⑤ "Premium Plan" means the extended service available through a paid subscription.

⑥ "Content" means all data a Member enters or stores while using the Services, including counseling records, prescriptions, medication schedules, and mood check-ins.

terms_sections.title: Article 3 (Posting and Amendment of these Terms)
terms_sections.body:
① The Company posts these Terms via the Service's initial screen or a linked screen so that Users can readily understand the contents.

② The Company may amend these Terms to the extent that the amendment does not violate applicable laws.

③ Where the Company amends these Terms, it will give notice — along with the current Terms — from seven days before the effective date, specifying the effective date and the reasons for the amendment, via announcements within the Services or individual notifications. Where the amendment is unfavorable to Users, notice will be given at least 30 days in advance.

④ If a User does not agree to the amended Terms, the User may terminate the service-use agreement. A User who continues to use the Services after the amended Terms take effect is deemed to have agreed to the amended Terms.

terms_sections.title: Article 4 (Formation of the Service-Use Agreement)
terms_sections.body:
① A service-use agreement is formed when a User agrees to these Terms and applies for service registration, and the Company accepts that application.

② The Company supports registration via social sign-in (Google, Apple).

③ The Company may refuse a registration application or subsequently terminate the service-use agreement in the following cases:
a. Where the applicant has used another person's name or information.
b. Where the applicant is under 14 years of age.
c. Where the applicant's service-use agreement was previously terminated and the applicant is re-applying.
d. Where the application otherwise violates applicable laws or these Terms.

terms_sections.title: Article 5 (Provision and Modification of the Services)
terms_sections.body:
① The Company provides the following Services:
a. Management and recording of psychiatry and psychological counseling appointments.
b. Prescription registration and automatic OCR recognition; management of medication schedules and reminders.
c. Mood check-ins and records.
d. Creation of prep notes for appointments.
e. Data export (PDF).
f. Other services that the Company develops additionally or provides through partnerships.

② The features available on the Free Plan and the Premium Plan may differ. The details of each plan are available within the Services.

③ Where the Company changes the content or operation of the Services, it will give advance notice of the reason, content, and effective date of the change.

terms_sections.title: Article 6 (Suspension of the Services)
terms_sections.body:
① The Company may temporarily suspend the Services in the event of maintenance, repair, replacement, or failure of computers or other information and communications equipment, or loss of communications.

② The Company is not liable for damages incurred by Users or third parties due to temporary suspension of the Services under Paragraph 1, except in cases of the Company's willful misconduct or gross negligence.

③ Where the Company is unable to continue providing the Services due to a change of business, abandonment of business, merger, or similar reason, the Company will give advance notice to Users and take appropriate measures regarding the termination of the Services.

terms_sections.title: Article 7 (Management of Member Information)
terms_sections.body:
① Members must keep their social account and in-service information current. Disadvantages resulting from inaccurate information are the Member's responsibility.

② Members must thoroughly manage the security of their social accounts and may not transfer or lend them to any third party.

③ Upon becoming aware that a social account has been misappropriated or used by a third party, the Member must immediately notify the Company and follow the Company's guidance.

terms_sections.title: Article 8 (User Obligations)
terms_sections.body:
Users must not engage in any of the following conduct.

① Registering false information when applying or making changes.
② Altering information posted on the Services, or using information obtained from the Services for reproduction, publication, broadcast, or similar purposes, or providing such information to third parties, without the Company's prior consent.
③ Infringing the intellectual property rights, including copyrights, of the Company or third parties.
④ Damaging the reputation of, or interfering with the operations of, the Company or third parties.
⑤ Publishing or posting obscene or violent information through the Services.
⑥ Interfering with the stable operation of the Services, including through hacking or the distribution of malware.
⑦ Violating applicable laws, these Terms, or Company policy.

terms_sections.title: Article 9 (Company Obligations)
terms_sections.body:
① The Company will not engage in conduct prohibited by applicable laws or these Terms, or conduct contrary to public morals, and will use its best efforts to provide the Services continuously and stably.

② The Company maintains security systems to safely process Users' personal information (including health-related data) and discloses and complies with its Privacy Policy.

③ Where the Company deems a User opinion or complaint regarding use of the Services to be reasonable, the Company will address it and communicate the outcome to the User by email (yamisupport@gmail.com) or similar means.

terms_sections.title: Article 10 (Paid Services and Payment)
terms_sections.body:
① The Company may offer paid services, including the Premium Plan, and Users who wish to use paid services must pay the fees set by the Company.

② Payment methods are as follows:
a. iOS: in-app purchase (IAP) via the Apple App Store.
b. Android: in-app purchase via Google Play or payment via Toss Payments.

③ Details such as paid-service fees and subscription renewal cycles are displayed on the payment screen within the Services and are made available for review before payment.

④ Subscription services renew automatically unless the User cancels the subscription. Automatic renewal must be cancelled directly on the subscription management screen of the App Store or Google Play.

terms_sections.title: Article 11 (Withdrawal of Subscription and Refunds)
terms_sections.body:
① A User may withdraw a purchase of a paid service within 7 days of the purchase date. However, where the Content has already been used or where a refund is not possible due to the nature of the service, withdrawal may be restricted.

② The refund policies of the payment platforms (App Store, Google Play) take precedence, and refund requests must be made through each platform's refund procedure. The Company generally cannot process refunds directly for payments made through these platforms.

③ Where a User is unable to use the Services due to the Company's fault, the User may request a refund from the Company, and the Company will process it within a reasonable period.

terms_sections.title: Article 12 (Special Handling of Health Information)
terms_sections.body:
① The Services allow Users to enter and store sensitive health information, including counseling records, prescriptions, medication information, and mood states, and the Company securely stores such information in encrypted form.

② Health-related information stored in the Services may be viewed, modified, or deleted only by the User. The Company does not provide such information to third parties except as required by law.

③ OCR analysis of prescription images uses the Anthropic API, and image data is deleted immediately upon completion of processing.

④ The Services are not medical services, and no information provided through the Services is a substitute for professional medical diagnosis, prescription, or treatment.

terms_sections.title: Article 13 (Ownership and Management of Content)
terms_sections.body:
① Copyright in Content created or entered by a User within the Services belongs to the User.

② Users may at any time download data generated through their use of the Services, including by exporting it as PDF.

③ Upon account deletion, a User's Content is soft-deleted and then permanently deleted within 30 days. Once deleted, such data cannot be recovered.

terms_sections.title: Article 14 (Restrictions on Use of the Services)
terms_sections.body:
① Where a User violates obligations under these Terms or interferes with the normal operation of the Services, the Company may take measures such as warnings, temporary suspension, or permanent suspension of use.

② Where a User violates applicable laws, the Company may immediately terminate the service-use agreement and report the matter to investigative authorities.

③ Where the Company restricts a User's use of the Services or terminates the agreement, the Company will notify the User of that fact.

terms_sections.title: Article 15 (Termination and Account Deletion)
terms_sections.body:
① A User may at any time terminate the service-use agreement and delete their account through the in-service "Delete Account" function.

② Upon account deletion, the User's personal information and Content are handled in accordance with the Privacy Policy.

③ Where a User deletes their account while subscribed to the Premium Plan, the subscription is automatically terminated. Refunds for any remaining subscription period follow the refund policy of each app store.

④ Once account deletion is completed, the account cannot be recovered. Please make this decision with care.

terms_sections.title: Article 16 (Indemnification)
terms_sections.body:
① The Company is not liable to compensate Users for damages arising in connection with services provided free of charge, except in cases of the Company's willful misconduct or gross negligence.

② Where a User incurs damages in connection with paid services due to causes attributable to the Company, the Company's liability is limited to the fees that the User paid over the most recent three months.

③ Where a User causes damages to the Company by violating these Terms or applicable laws, the User must compensate the Company for such damages.

terms_sections.title: Article 17 (Disclaimer)
terms_sections.body:
① The Company is not liable for suspension of the Services due to force majeure, including natural disasters, war, suspension of service by telecommunications carriers, or technical failures.

② The Company is not liable for interference with use of the Services caused by reasons attributable to the User.

③ The Company is not liable for Users' failure to obtain expected revenue from use of the Services, nor for damages arising from information obtained through the Services.

④ The Services are not medical services, and the Company is not liable for any health-related outcomes arising from use of the Services.

terms_sections.title: Article 18 (Dispute Resolution)
terms_sections.body:
① The Company will make every effort to promptly address User opinions and complaints in any dispute arising between the Company and a User.

② Users may report complaints or disputes related to the Services to yamisupport@gmail.com.

③ Any litigation between the Company and a User is governed by the laws of the Republic of Korea, and the court with jurisdiction over the location of the Company's head office shall be the competent court.

terms_sections.title: Article 19 (Governing Law)
terms_sections.body: The interpretation and application of these Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Korea, and any dispute related to use of the Services may be brought before the courts of the Republic of Korea.
